changes: Preflights historical NewzDeck SAB localhost ports with a cheap TCP listener check before sending any HTTP identity request, so known-dead/free historical ports are skipped without generating mode=version transport resets.

Retains full SAB version plus historical API-key authentication when a historical port is actually occupied, preserving stale-engine quarantine safety while eliminating pointless probes against closed ports.
Adds Historical SAB sweep diagnostics for sweeps, ports considered, closed-port skips, occupied probes, authenticated stale engines, and last sweep time.
Preserves the accepted v3.6.30 runtime-auth/no-op synchronization behavior, v3.6.29 persistent serialized HTTP/1.1 transport, and v3.6.28 Downloads visibility continuity unchanged.
regression_guards: The authoritative current SAB port is never subject to the historical-port preflight skip path.
Any occupied historical port still requires a real key-free SAB version fingerprint followed by authentication with a historical NewzDeck-owned API key before pause or shutdown is allowed.
Unknown processes on historical ports are never adopted, paused, shut down, or otherwise mutated.
v3.6.30 runtime authentication, v3.6.29 persistent transport serialization/reconnect behavior, and v3.6.28 visibility continuity/fresh Queue+History absence rules remain unchanged.
Discover/TMDB, Metadata Server v0.3.3 integration, Smart Import, provider settings, installer/updater behavior, and user data preservation are otherwise unchanged.
name: SAB Identity Probe Stabilization
